questions.q: Who is coming to visit the host?
o: A brother with his family: two adults and two children
questions.e: In the video: "Danas mi dolaze gosti: dve odrasle osobe i dvoje dece" — today I'm having guests: two adults and two children.

questions.q: How does she want to set out the food?
o: A buffet on the kitchen counter
questions.e: In the video: "ne postavljam standardno sto, nego pult bude kao švedski sto" — I'm not setting up a standard table, but the counter will be like a buffet.

questions.q: What is the tortilla dough made from, and with what?
o: Flour, yogurt, baking powder and a little salt
questions.e: In the video: "ide brašno, jogurt, prašak za pecivo i malo soli" — in goes flour, yogurt, baking powder and a little salt.

questions.q: By what method does she measure the ingredients?
o: By a recipe from a book
questions.e: In the video: "Danas idemo odokativnom metodom" — today we're going by the "by-eye" method.

questions.q: What meat did she take instead of turkey?
questions.e: In the video: "Ja sam uzela juneće meso" — I took beef.

questions.q: Why is the onion and pepper mixture put in a colander?
o: To release water so the meat isn't watery
questions.e: In the video: "da ne bude dosta vodenasto ovo meso" — so that this meat isn't too watery.

questions.q: How long does the meat bake in the oven?
questions.e: In the video: "To se peče nekih četrdeset minuta" — it bakes for about forty minutes.

questions.q: What did she decide to add to the salad, although the recipe doesn't call for it?
questions.e: In the video: "ali može malo mladog luka" — but a little spring onion is fine.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.q: Idem u *špajz* po brašno.
questions.e: Špajz — a food pantry.

questions.q: Treba mi jedna velika *činija*.
questions.e: Činija — a bowl.

questions.q: Uzmite veliki *pleh* od rerne.
questions.e: Pleh — a baking tray.

questions.q: Moram da *iseckam* luk i papriku.
questions.e: Iseckati — to slice, to chop.

questions.q: Ovo testo se ne *lepi* za ruke.
questions.e: Lepiti se — to stick.

questions.q: Smesa stoji u *zamrzivaču* šest meseci.
questions.e: Zamrzivač — a freezer, a freezer compartment.

questions.q: Dodajte malo *sirćeta* i soli.
questions.e: Sirće — vinegar.

questions.q: Koliko god, nadam se da vam je bio od *koristi*.
questions.e: Od koristi — "useful": biti od koristi.

questions.q: Idem u špajz po ___.
questions.e: Po + accusative case: "to fetch something" — po brašno.

questions.q: Stavit ću malo više od pola ___ za pecivo.
questions.e: Pola + genitive case: pola praška.

questions.q: Mešamo ga sa malo limunovog ___.
questions.e: Malo + genitive case: malo limunovog soka.

questions.q: Salata ide u ___ da se ohladi.
questions.e: U + accusative case (where to?): u frižider.

questions.q: Smesu formiramo ___ ili oklagijom.
questions.e: With what? — instrumental case: rukama ili oklagijom.

questions.q: Mleveno meso izručimo na ___.
questions.e: Na + accusative case (where to?): na površinu.

questions.q: Ne stavljam puno ___.
questions.e: Puno + genitive case: puno ulja.

questions.q: Zahvaljujem vam se ___ podršku.
questions.e: Zahvaliti se za nešto — to thank for something: za + accusative.
